purpose: Searchable state and city dropdowns for Brazil using the IBGE Districts API with Hive caching

data_source.fallback: serve stale cache if API unreachable

conventions.hive_type_ids: Location=0, CacheData=1 — never reuse or change these
conventions.city_format: Full city name as returned by IBGE
conventions.generated_files: *.g.dart are committed and must be regenerated after model changes

ai_context_hints: All platform channel implementations (kotlin/swift/cc/cpp) are stubs — do not add logic there
CacheService is stateless; Hive box holds all persistent state
The public API is intentionally a single widget with many optional styling params
Do not change Hive typeId values — they identify stored binary data and changing them breaks existing caches
The package targets pub.dev so avoid adding heavy dependencies that could conflict with consumer apps
